results.summary: This design implements a 7-node Hopfield associative memory storing two 7-segment patterns, digit 1 and digit 9. It uses Hebbian-computed weights and synchronous updates each clock cycle to recall the nearest stored digit from noisy or partial input. The decimal point output goes high when the network converges. The design is implemented in Verilog and uses about 140 gate equivalents.

results.summary: This project is a 1-bit full adder that adds three binary inputs A, B, and Cin to produce Sum and Cout. It is built with XOR, AND, and OR gates implementing Sum = A XOR B XOR Cin and Cout = (A AND B) OR (Cin AND (A XOR B)). The design is combinational and can be cascaded to form multi-bit adders. It is implemented in Wokwi and tested with switches and LEDs.
